goal:
T73 — prompt Arena: tell BOTH lanes the interface the hidden acceptance tests call. Production 2026-10-30 (password
strength meter): EvoForge's own Critic passed 3/3, yet the judge's hidden tests scored 0/5 for both lanes — they called
an interface neither Builder was told about, so the result measured guessing, not quality. API only.
1. evoforge/arena_prompt.py: acceptance_interface(suite) -> sorted list of {"name", "arities", "keys"}: every attribute
   of the module `app` the suite's tests reference (ast, never regex; unparsable tests skipped), the sorted set of
   positional-argument counts of calls to it, and the sorted string keys of dict literals passed to those calls.
   Nothing else from the tests (no expected values, test names or code). interface_text(iface) -> one deterministic
   sentence naming each function, its argument counts and input keys ("" for an empty interface).
2. TEMPLATE: render(state=None) (preview() still returns render()); JUDGE_INSTRUCTION also says that when the result
   depends on user input, tests call app.render(state) with a dict of input values; TASK_INSTRUCTION says
   render(state=None).
3. After the judge suite is filtered (kept), append interface_text(kept interface) to the task goal both lanes get
   (first round AND follow-ups; the EvoForge lane's own Critic sees the same goal) — identical text for both lanes.
4. Manifest: "acceptance_interface" (the list) and "interface_hash" ("sha256:" + hex of the canonical JSON), first
   round and follow-ups.
Keep every existing prompt-Arena test green (judge test names must never reach a lane).
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t73.py.
